integrity: Analytical argument is primary; finite executable checks are corroborating evidence, and an independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local fixed-point results only: no classification of global basins, periodic or chaotic attractors.
Assumes n>=3, 1<r<3, inhibitory strength gamma>1, a directed single cyclic edge per site, and [0,1] clipping.
At the odd-ring spectral equality no assertion of nonlinear or Lyapunov stability is made.
External historical priority has not been independently verified.
title: Lucas equilibrium census and parity-sharp stability in a directed inhibitory logistic ring
